

MISSISSIPPI LEGISLATURE

2026 Regular Session

To: Rules

By: Representative White

House Concurrent Resolution 21

(As Adopted by House)

A CONCURRENT RESOLUTION PROVIDING FOR A JOINT SESSION OF THE
MISSISSIPPI LEGISLATURE TO HEAR THE STATE OF THE STATE ADDRESS OF GOVERNOR TATE
REEVES.

     BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE
OF REPRESENTATIVES OF THE STATE OF MISSISSIPPI, THE SENATE CONCURRING THEREIN,
That a joint session of the House of Representatives and the Senate shall be
held in the Second Floor Rotunda of the New Capitol Building, on Wednesday,
February 4, 2026, at 5:00 p.m., to hear the State of the State address of
Governor Tate Reeves.
